messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're planning a schema change in console analytics: rename column partition_key -> route_key and canonicalize values (lowercase + trim). This touches ingestion partitions, quota joins, and dashboards. Need a rollout/backfill plan.

dylan: Is this purely a rename or are semantics changing? can we just alias at read-time to reduce risk?

maria: It's mostly a rename but we'll normalize values too (old values have mixed case and stray prefixes). We want canonical route_key to simplify routing policies. Plan is dual-write from API + backfill historical rows + read-time fallback for a short window.

kai: Dual-write plumbing — do we have feature flag ready? Also worried about big GROUP BY queries on the old column impacting p99.

sam: I think we can use a read adapter shim: coalesce(route_key, partition_key) for 4 weeks, and create a materialized view used by dashboards to avoid heavy compute on the live table.

analytics-bot: quick estimate: total rows ~1.2B, distinct partition_key values ~4M, heavy skew across ~1k tenants. Recommend throttled backfill and partitioned workers.

maria: Timeline proposal: 1) enable dual-write behind flag, 2) backfill a canary tenant range (ids 100-200) overnight, 3) validate dashboards + quota joins, 4) global backfill in 24h windows, 5) deprecate old column after 6 weeks, 6) drop column.

dylan: For quota joins we'll add compatibility: join on route_id = coalesce(route_key, partition_key) so no immediate churn for rate limiting. Also add a migration test in staging.

kai: SQL plan sketch: ```
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN route_key text;
-- dual-write will populate route_key going forward
-- canary backfill for tenants 100-200
UPDATE console_events SET route_key = lower(trim(partition_key)) WHERE tenant_id BETWEEN 100 AND 200 AND route_key IS NULL;
```
We should avoid table rewrite. Use small batch updates by partition to keep locks short.

maria: App SDK/API note: we'll accept both param names (partition_key and route_key) for 6 weeks. Please add a deprecation header in responses so integrators can migrate.

sam: I'll prepare the Looker/BI layer change: create view console_events_v2 that exposes route_key and keeps old name as alias. Will coordinate with BI to update alerts that group by partition_key.

dylan: Backfill ops: create backfill job that shards by tenant_range; estimate canary (100-200) ~ 45m, global full run ~ 18-24h with throttling. Job ids: bg-3745 (canary), bg-3746 (staging run).

maria: Rollback plan: disable dual-write, flip read adapter to prefer partition_key exclusively, cancel running backfills (job bg-3745), redeploy. We'll keep old column until we're 100% green.

analytics-bot: watchlist: top 10 tenants by qps, queries using GROUP BY partition_key, dashboards with heavy aggregation. Recommend running explain plans on canary before global backfill.

kai: Also add alert on console p95/p99 for queries touching console_events.

dylan: We should add a lightweight compatibility migration test: write both keys for random routes and run queries against both paths to verify parity.

maria: I'll write the runbook and feature flag playbook tonight and post link here. Deploy plan for canary dual-write set for tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: canary dual-write deployed to eu1 at 2025-04-26T10:12:00Z :thumbsup:

sam: I'll sync with BI on alerts and update dashboards to point to console_events_v2. Ping me if anything breaks.

maria: thanks all — posting runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/partition_key_to_route_key (draft). Please ack once you've pulled the change into your testbeds.
